task: Investigate the 'transformers' library in the Hugging Face documentation, focusing on how to add new tokens to a tokenizer.
answer: Investigated the Hugging Face transformers documentation on adding new tokens to a tokenizer. Key findings from https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main_classes/tokenizer: (1) tokenizer.add_tokens(new_tokens, special_tokens=False) -> int adds new tokens (str, AddedToken, or a sequence) only if not already in the vocabulary, returning the number of tokens added; (2) tokenizer.add_special_tokens(special_tokens_dict, replace_extra_special_tokens=True) -> int adds special tokens via a dict mapping attribute names to tokens; (3) after adding tokens, resize the model embeddings with model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer)). Documented example: tokenizer = BertTokenizerFast.from_pretrained('google-bert/bert-base-uncased'); model = BertModel.from_pretrained('google-bert/bert-base-uncased'); num_added_toks = tokenizer.add_tokens(['new_tok1', 'my_new-tok2']); model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer)).
